title: Upper bound on learner work
statement: For any natural numbers $n,\ell,m$ and any list of $m$ labeled examples from $\{\pm1\}^n$, the learner's work is at most $m(N+1)+Nm(N+2)+N(N+1)$, where $N$ is the number of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ of size at most $\ell$.
hypotheses_covered: natural numbers n, ℓ, and m
a list of m labeled examples
